description.p: OpenDictate is a native voice dictation and AI speech-to-text application. It combines private offline transcription with multi-provider Cloud AI models to turn spoken voice into clean, polished text.

ul.li: Offline on-device speech recognition powered by Whisper GGML models
Multi-provider Cloud AI transcription and text refinement
Hardware-aware microphone routing across System Default, Headphones, and Handsfree devices
Floating MiniBar overlay for hands-free dictation across active windows
Persistent local dictation history with quick clipboard copy and deletion
Interface localization across 28 languages with automatic dark and light themes
Wayland and X11 text insertion, system tray indicator, and global shortcuts

screenshot.caption: Main configuration window with local and cloud speech model settings
Floating MiniBar for quick desktop dictation

description.p: Major release featuring native GTK4 and Libadwaita interface, offline Whisper GGML speech recognition, multi-provider Cloud AI transcription, 28-language localization, and persistent SQLite dictation history.

ul.li: Native GTK4 and Libadwaita user interface with adaptive dark and light themes
Dual-engine speech recognition supporting offline Whisper models and Cloud AI providers
Real-time interface localization across 28 languages with Right-to-Left layout support
In-popover dictation history viewer with clipboard copy and record management
Floating MiniBar recording pill with live acoustic waveform visualization
